name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year to small and marginal farmer families, paid in three installments.
benefits: Rs. 6,000 per year direct income support in three equal installments.
how_to_apply: Register online at pmkisan.gov.in or visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with land records and Aadhaar.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Financial assistance for construction of a pucca house for rural families without a house or living in kutcha houses.
benefits: Financial assistance up to Rs. 1.2 lakh (plains) / Rs. 1.3 lakh (hilly areas) for house construction.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Gram Panchayat or online at pmayg.nic.in using the SECC-2011 database verification.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
description: Affordable housing scheme for urban poor with interest subsidy on home loans.
benefits: Interest subsidy of up to 6.5% on home loans depending on income category.
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmaymis.gov.in or through empanelled banks/housing finance companies.

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: Health insurance cover of Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation.
benefits: Cashless health cover up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in and get a PM-JAY card from the nearest empanelled hospital or Common Service Centre.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: Free LPG gas connection to women from below poverty line (BPL) households.
benefits: Free LPG connection with financial support for the first refill and stove.
how_to_apply: Apply at the nearest LPG distributor with Aadhaar, BPL certificate, and bank account details.

name: National Scholarship Portal - Post-Matric Scholarship
description: Financial assistance for students from economically weaker sections to pursue post-matriculation education.
benefits: Tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance depending on the course and category.
how_to_apply: Apply online at scholarships.gov.in with income certificate, mark sheets and bank details.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Pension scheme for workers in the unorganised sector, guaranteeing a fixed monthly pension after age 60.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 after the age of 60 based on contribution.
how_to_apply: Open an APY account through your bank or post office savings account.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: Savings scheme for the girl child offering high interest rate and tax benefits, to fund education and marriage.
benefits: High, government-guaranteed interest rate with tax benefits under Section 80C.
how_to_apply: Open an account at any post office or authorised bank branch in the girl child's name.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
description: Monthly pension for senior citizens living below the poverty line.
benefits: Monthly pension of Rs. 200 to Rs. 500 (varies by state, many states top this up).
how_to_apply: Apply at the local Panchayat/Municipal office or Social Welfare Department with age and income proof.

name: National Disability Pension Scheme
description: Monthly pension support for persons with severe or multiple disabilities from BPL households.
benefits: Monthly pension assistance (amount varies by state, typically Rs. 300 - Rs. 500).
how_to_apply: Apply at the local Social Welfare Department with disability certificate and income proof.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Collateral-free loans up to Rs. 10 lakh for non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises.
benefits: Collateral-free loans under Shishu (up to Rs. 50,000), Kishore (up to Rs. 5 lakh) and Tarun (up to Rs. 10 lakh) categories.
how_to_apply: Apply through any nationalised bank, RRB, cooperative bank, MFI or NBFC with a business plan.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
description: Free skill development training and certification for youth to improve employability.
benefits: Free industry-relevant skill training with certification and placement assistance.
how_to_apply: Register at pmkvyofficial.org or visit the nearest PMKVY training centre.
